1.w: God of vengeance, O YHWH, O God of vengeance, shine forth!

2.w: Rise up, O Judge of the earth! Return a recompense on the proud.

3.w: Until when [will] the wicked, O YHWH, until when [will] the wicked exult?

4.w: They pour out words of arrogance; all the workers of iniquity boast in themselves.

5.w: Your people, O YHWH, they crush, and Your heritage they afflict.

6.w: The widow and the foreigner they kill, and the fatherless they murder.

7.w: And they say, “Yah does not see, and the God of Jacob does not discern.”

8.w: Discern, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you⁺ be wise?

9.w: The One planting the ear, can He not hear? Or the One forming the eye, can He not see?

10.w: The One disciplining the nations, does He not correct—the One teaching a man knowledge?

11.w: YHWH knows the thoughts of man, that they [are] vapor.

12.w: Blessed [is] the man whom You instruct, O YAH, and teach him from Your law,

13.w: that You may give rest to him from the days of evil, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

14.w: For YHWH will not forsake His people, and he will not forsake His inheritance.

15.w: But to righteousness the judgment will return, and all the upright of heart will follow it.

16.w: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

17.w: Unless YHWH [had been] the help for me, My soul would soon have dwelt in silence.

18.w: When I said, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O YHWH, supports me.

19.w: In the abundance of my anxieties within me, Your comforts delighted my soul.

20.w: Can the throne of iniquity join with You—one shaping mischief by statute?

21.w: They band together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood.

22.w: And YHWH has become for me as a place up high, and my God as the rock of my refuge.

23.w: And He has turned back upon them their own iniquity, and in their wickedness He will finish them off—YHWH our God, will finish them off!
